We need to determine relation between two yes/no questions.

Question1: "A vacinação contra Covid-19 deve ser obrigatória para crianças de 6 meses a 5 anos?" (Should COVID-19 vaccination be mandatory for children aged 6 months to 5 years?)

Question2: "A vacinação contra Covid-19 deve ser obrigatória para crianças?" (Should COVID-19 vaccination be mandatory for children?)

The second is broader: all children (any age). The first is a specific age range. Are they equivalent? No, because the second includes older children beyond 5 years, and possibly younger than 6 months (though vaccination likely not for infants). So they are different questions. The answer to the first does not determine answer to second. So relation: DIFFERENT.

Thus output JSON with relation "DIFFERENT" and brief reasoning.
